notes.title: Prologue Patch Notes - v1.1.4
notes.notes:
Hi dear Gravediggers!
I’m charlermaster from the development team of Zombie Graveyard Simulator.

After last week's big update, many of you reached out with bug reports!
As we shared in our previous post, the full version of the game is coming June 5th, but until then, we’re continuing to support and improve the Prologue/Demo experience.

Today, we’ve released a new bug fix patch addressing several issues you've reported.

⚠️ Important: This patch includes major internal changes to the Tutorial system infrastructure. Because of that, old save files will no longer be compatible with this new version!

Here’s what’s fixed in this update:

🐞 Bug Fixes

 Total Profit UI layout adjusted
 Full system overhaul for the Tutorial to prevent it from breaking when exiting the game mid-step
 Fixed softlock when saving during night and reloading the game
 Fixed a bug where dropping a gravestone during tutorial incorrectly completed the Flower Stand step
 Fixed incorrect input icon shown for Aim in the controls UI
 Fixed stock count decreasing incorrectly during flower sales
 Fixed a visual bug where a moved dirty grave could still appear clean in stats
 Fixed flower requests not appearing on graves after loading a save
 Fixed locked flower types being requested by visitors before unlocking
 Added daily task related to the Donation Box at day start
 Fixed cremated corpse still triggering body indicator on graves
 Fixed Farm Info UI freezing the game if tutorial finishes at night
 Corrected incorrect Turkish translation for Notification_NearPickupDeactive
 Fixed grave status incorrectly showing as "filled" even if HP wasn’t full
 Fixed night tutorial completion freezing the game at the next day
 Fixed objectives not appearing after completing night tutorial due to canvas group bug
 Fixed price doubling when adding a second stack of the same item in the Market
 Fixed bug where removing the first of two stacked items in the Dark Market removed the wrong item


If you're enjoying the game and want to support us:

 Don’t forget to wishlist the full game on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3430450/Zombie_Graveyard_Simulator/
 Join our Discord to share feedback or just hang out with the community!

notes.title: Patch Notes #1 - Renovation, New Characters and Much More!
notes.notes:
Hi dear Gravediggers!
I’m charlermaster from the development team of Zombie Graveyard Simulator.

First of all – a massive thank you to over 20,000 people who have played the game so far!
 
As we inch closer to release, we’ve just pushed a new update for the Prologue that includes some of the changes we talked about in our latest Development Update on the main game page.

Here’s a quick summary of what’s now available to try:

🔨 Renovation System – Build Your Graveyard, Your Way
In the earlier versions of the game, your graveyard was basically handed to you clean, tidy, and ready to go. Now all areas start locked and rundown. You need to pay to unlock them and renovate before using!

Once renovated, these stations actually matter!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567903/c30a6f02ca0544f42576dd9f03cfb54fe032a74d.png
One perfect example is the Chapel’s new donation box. It will now generate income based on your graveyard’s decoration and cleanliness level. The better you maintain your graveyard, the more generous your visitors will be. You’ll also notice new visitor behaviors and actions unique to these spaces.

🧍‍♀️ New Character Models – No More Clones!
Let’s be honest, we all noticed it. The old character models looked like they were from the same extended family… or military squad.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567903/08cce08649af42529093ed4d6622ae79793c5c63.png
We’ve introduced a whole new set of character models, with both male and female designs, a variety of faces, hairstyles, clothing, and colors. The graveyard now feels more alive and diverse, just like it should.

You can check out our Development Update for all details! For now here’s the full list of what’s packed into this update:

✨ New Stuff

 Added relaxed mode for more chill night experience
 Renovation system added to all major areas
 Chapel, Farm and Crematorium areas now starts locked and requires renovation; includes new features like the donation box and repairable stations
 Visitors now show more activity and react with new messages in various situations (e.g. when receiving wrong flowers, waiting in line, visiting the Chapel, etc.)
 Over 30 new items added, including defense, weapons, gravestones, flowers, and decorations
 New character models and genders added
 Old animations replaced and many new animations added to match new characters
 Multiple new ambient and item-related sounds added
 Zombie attack and AI systems improved – zombies are now prioritize graveyard targets; they also commit to attacks even after taking damage mid-swing
 Delivery vehicle now returns after all corpses are picked up
 You can now request more than one delivery per day
 Added two new settings, Additional Brightness and Shadow Distance


🐞 Bug Fixes

 Widescreen resolution and UI scaling now work correctly
 Fixed an issue where the tutorial panel could get stuck on screen
 Fixed an issue where pressing Escape would incorrectly open the Pause Menu
 Fixed an issue where placing multiple flower types on the Flower Stand would still add the previous flower to the bouquet
 Fixed incorrect mouse sensitivity when a controller was connected but playing with keyboard & mouse
 Fixed controller button prompts appearing in the UI when playing with keyboard & mouse while a controller was plugged in
 Fixed a Save & Load bug that could corrupt save files
 Fixed a Save & Load issue that prevented saving after a certain in-game day
 Fixed a Save & Load issue where placed structures wouldn't appear after loading
 Fixed a bug where customers could receive multiple flowers in a single bouquet
 Fixed an issue where harvested plants didn’t yield items after reloading a save
 Fixed an issue where visitors could get stuck in certain areas
 Fixed tutorial panels overlapping and cutting off each other


If you’re enjoying the game and want to support us, don’t forget to:

 Follow and Wishlist the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3430450/Zombie_Graveyard_Simulator/
 Join our Discord to share feedback, ideas, or just say hi!
We’re always around and would love to hear from you.
